output.reason: The only prose evidence is a one-line PR title [ev-61893aebc612]. It does not say whether existing configurations are affected, so the proposal's claim that "the evidence states no operational consequence" goes beyond what the evidence says. That line also sits under a "BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed" heading. The CRD validator found spec.provider.aws.prefix in both the v0.15.0 and v0.16.0 schemas [ev-9889c9b8706d][ev-e08924afdc47], which casts doubt on a plain "new optional field, no effect" reading. To settle the consequence, we need the description of PR #4612 or the release's breaking-changes text, showing whether the prefix changes how existing AWS Secrets Manager lookups resolve.
